name: CI
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - '*'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - '*'
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os:
          - macos-latest
          - ubuntu-latest
          - windows-latest
        # Keep this list as: all supported LTS JDKs, the latest GA JDK, and optionally the latest EA JDK (if available).
        # Reference: https://adoptium.net/support/
        java:
          - 17
          - 21
          - 25
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6
      - name: Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java }}
        uses: actions/setup-java@b6effb05e454b25005698d916606bdc6ffcbf961 # v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
          cache: maven
      - name: Build with Maven
        # In order to support Windows PowerShell, a space between --define property=true is required.
        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify --define skipTests=true
  native:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6
      - name: Set up GraalVM
        uses: graalvm/setup-graalvm@d6eca2595046623d69d636041513c80abf745406
        with:
          java-version: '25'
          distribution: 'graalvm-community'
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          cache: maven
      - name: Build and verify native image
        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify --define skipTests=true -Pnative

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
